text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of our clash against Narita<n>Taishin at the
spring Tenno Sho has<n>arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The switch in venue from the Kyoto<n>Racecourse to
the Hanshin<n>Racecourse has necessitated some
adjustments to the winning equation,<n>but Biwa
Hayahide isn't worried.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit burns brightly within<n>her as she
aims for first place.
